en: to avoid; to evade; to shirk

examples.en: Many people avoid hard work.

examples.ko: 그 학생은 발표를 기피하려고 아픈 척했어요.
examples.en: That student pretended to be sick to get out of presenting.

examples.ko: 젊은 사람들이 시골 근무를 기피하는 경향이 있어요.
examples.en: Young people tend to shun working in the countryside.

examples.ko: 다들 청소 당번을 기피해서 제가 했어요.
examples.en: Everyone avoided cleaning duty, so I did it.
If you dodge responsibility, you lose trust.
It was a job so hard that everyone wanted to avoid it.

explain: 기피하다는 싫거나 부담스러워서 일부러 피할 때 써요. '피하다'는 비를 피하는 것처럼 눈에 보이는 상황에도 쓰지만, 기피하다는 일, 책임, 사람처럼 마음이 내키지 않는 대상에 써요. '병역 기피'처럼 굳은 말도 많아요.
explain_en: This is for deliberately steering clear of something you dislike or find burdensome. '피하다' also works for physical situations like dodging rain, but '기피하다' is for work, responsibility, or people you are reluctant about. It also appears in set phrases like '병역 기피' (draft evasion).

examples.en: Tell me the truth, who did it?
The teacher said that if we tell the truth, we'll be forgiven.
I told my mom everything honestly and apologized.

examples.ko: 바른대로 말하면 저는 그 일을 몰랐어요.
examples.en: To tell the truth, I didn't know about that.
Don't lie, just come clean.

examples.ko: 그때 바른대로 말하지 못한 게 계속 마음에 걸려요.
examples.en: It still weighs on me that I couldn't tell the truth back then.

explain: '바른대로 말하다, 바른대로 대다, 바른대로 이르다'처럼 말하는 것과 함께 써요. '사실대로'와 비슷하지만 잘못을 캐묻거나 솔직하게 털어놓으라고 할 때 더 자주 들려요.
explain_en: It goes with speaking verbs, as in '바른대로 말하다', '바른대로 대다' and '바른대로 이르다'. It is close to '사실대로', but it is heard more when someone is pressing for the truth or urging a confession.

examples.ko: 질문을 받자 그는 어물거리며 대답을 피했어요.
examples.en: When asked, he mumbled and avoided answering.
Don't mumble; say it clearly.

examples.ko: 입안에서 말이 어물거려서 알아들을 수 없었어요.
examples.en: The words mumbled in his mouth, so I couldn't make them out.

examples.ko: 왜 자꾸 어물거려요? 하고 싶은 말이 뭐예요?
examples.en: Why do you keep hesitating? What do you want to say?
I dawdled from the morning and ended up late.
While he was dithering, the chance was gone.

explain: 말이나 행동을 분명하게 하지 않고 우물쭈물하거나 굼뜰 때 써요. 말에 쓰면 '얼버무리다', 행동에 쓰면 '꾸물거리다'와 느낌이 비슷해요.
explain_en: It is used when someone is vague or slow in speech or action. About speech it feels like '얼버무리다' (to mumble evasively), and about actions it feels like '꾸물거리다' (to dawdle).

examples.en: He hesitated in front of the door and then came in.

examples.ko: 갑자기 개가 나타나서 저도 모르게 주춤거렸어요.
examples.en: A dog suddenly appeared, and I flinched without meaning to.
Don't hang back. Come in quickly.
The child hangs back in front of strangers.
The way he answered, faltering, looked awkward.
The person ahead hesitated, and the line got blocked.

explain: 놀라거나 망설여서 동작을 잠깐 멈추거나 뒤로 물러나는 모습이에요. '주저하다'는 마음속 망설임에 가깝고, '주춤거리다'는 몸의 움직임이 눈에 보여요. '주춤하다'라고도 써요.
explain_en: It shows someone briefly stopping or drawing back out of surprise or uncertainty. '주저하다' is closer to inner hesitation, while '주춤거리다' is visible in the body's movement. You can also say '주춤하다'.

en: to gibber; to babble; to ramble

examples.en: I was so nervous that I kept rambling in the interview.

examples.ko: 그가 횡설수설해서 끝까지 들어도 무슨 말인지 하나도 모르겠더라고요.
examples.en: He was babbling so much that even after hearing it all, I had no idea what he meant.

examples.ko: 열이 심하게 난 친구가 횡설수설하던 말은 다음 날 아무도 기억하지 못했어요.
examples.en: Nobody remembered the nonsense my feverish friend was babbling the next day.

examples.ko: 횡설수설하지 말고 천천히 차근차근 말해 봐요.
examples.en: Don't ramble; try telling it slowly, step by step.

examples.ko: 동생이 졸린 목소리로 횡설수설하길래 그냥 재웠어요.
examples.en: My younger sibling was mumbling nonsense in a sleepy voice, so I just put them to bed.

examples.ko: 발표 중에 횡설수설하면 사람들이 집중하지 못해요.
examples.en: If you ramble during a presentation, people can't focus.

explain: 말이 앞뒤가 맞지 않고 뒤죽박죽일 때 써요. '중언부언하다'는 같은 말을 되풀이하는 느낌이 더 강해요. '횡설수설'만 명사처럼 쓰기도 해서 '횡설수설을 늘어놓다'라고도 말해요.
explain_en: Use it when someone's words don't connect and come out in a jumble. '중언부언하다' has a stronger feel of repeating the same thing. '횡설수설' can also be used alone as a noun, as in '횡설수설을 늘어놓다'.
